title: Staff
readOnlyHint: Your subscription is read-only, so changes are paused.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to staff
noAccess.hint: Ask an administrator to grant you the staff permission.

add.title: Add staff member
add.inviteHint: They'll get an email to activate their own account and set a password.
add.directHint: For on-ground staff without email. You'll get a username and temporary password to hand over.

form.name: Full name
form.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, . _ - (3–30 characters). No spaces or @.
form.passwordHint: Leave blank to generate one automatically.
form.sendWelcome: Send a welcome email with the login link
form.emailImmutable: Email can't be changed. To use a new address, disable this member and send a new invite.
form.ownRoleLocked: You can't change your own role.

credentials.title: Account credentials
credentials.warning: Save these now — the temporary password is shown only once and can't be retrieved later. Share it with {name} securely.

reset.title: Reset password?
reset.body: This generates a new temporary password for {name}, signs them out everywhere, and forces a change on next login.

forceChange.title: Set a new password
forceChange.subtitle: Your account uses a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
forceChange.tooWeak: The password must be at least 8 characters and include a letter and a number.

empty.noMatchHint: Try a different name, role or status.
empty.emptyHint: Add your first team member to get started.

disable.title: Disable staff member?
disable.body: Disabling {name} revokes their access immediately and signs them out. Their records are kept.
